english.title: Make declaration accompanying application for anonymous registration knowing not entitled to vote etc
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in making an application for an anonymous entry in the register of

(A)_[parliamentary electors for the constituency]_
(B)_[local government electors for the local government area of]_

**(..SPECIFY CONSTITUENCY OR LOCAL GOVERNMENT AREA..), made a declaration under section 9B(1A)(a) of the Representation of the People Act 1983
